name: Fireshaper
body:
The Lord of Flame has granted you the power to shape natural fires.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is The Lord of Flame, or a god of fire

Benefit: You may cast the spell fireshape as a spell-like ability once per day. Your caster level is half your character level (minimum 1).
